note: Forest Service campground on Koomer Ridge in the heart of the Red River Gorge (Daniel Boone NF), off KY-15 near Pine Ridge. Wooded, shaded sites; 19 of the 54 take RVs and trailers. Rigs over 34 ft can't make the entrance turn and the parking aprons are paved only for the first 20 ft, so aim for a mid-size rig. Trailheads to Hidden Arch, Silvermine Arch and the Cliff Trail. --Claude
